title: Discovering physical mechanisms from experiment-simulation mismatches
abstract: arXiv:2604.26703v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery often begins where observation and prediction disagree. As computation and machine learning survey chemical space, experiment-simulation mismatches are exposed at scale, while tracing them to physical mechanisms remains expert-led. Here we present eXplainable DFT (XDFT), a self-evolving agent that turns this process into an executable search. XDFT formalizes candidate mechanisms as executable hypotheses, adjudicates their consequences against experiment and distils trajectories into priors for later searches. This couples a solving loop from mismatch to mechanism with a learning loop through which solving changes the solver. Across 112 source-audited cases in which standard calculations predict a metal whereas experiments find a semiconductor, XDFT resolved 105 with evidence-supported mechanisms within a single-GPU envelope. translated_title: 从实验-模拟不匹配中发现物理机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.26703v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：科学发现往往始于观察与预测不一致之处。随着计算和机器学习对化学空间进行探索，实验-模拟不匹配在大规模上被暴露出来，而将其追溯到物理机制仍由专家主导。在此，我们提出可解释密度泛函理论（XDFT），这是一种自我进化的智能体，它将这一过程转变为可执行的搜索。XDFT将候选机制形式化为可执行假设，根据实验结果评判其后果，并将轨迹提炼为先验知识用于后续搜索。这结合了从不匹配到机制的求解循环，以及通过求解改变求解器的学习循环。在112个经来源审计的案例中，标准计算预测为金属而实验发现为半导体的情形下，XDFT在单GPU范围内解决了105个案例，并提供了有证据支持的机制。经过60个案例后，解析机制在假设中排名前三。
tldr: 本文提出XDFT智能体，通过将候选机制形式化为可执行假设并迭代学习，成功从实验-模拟不匹配中自动发现物理机制，在112个案例中解决了105个。
en_tdlr: This paper presents XDFT, a self-evolving agent that formalizes candidate mechanisms as executable hypotheses and iteratively learns, successfully discovering physical mechanisms from experiment-simulation mismatches, resolving 105 out of 112 cases.
